Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules in document CHEMBL4420072. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to enforce availability of canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4420072'. Order rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
